attempt: Serialize a fully loaded Hytale BlockType using its CODEC to extract the native TransitionToTag value.

environment: Hytale 0.7.2 d769dc3d, Java 25; isolated AdaptiveSurface 0.10.0 development test
conditions: Full BlockType serialization after asset loading
Native block state graph may contain cycles
workaround: Use the public group/transition getters. For the protected tag without a public getter, read it from a native shallow BlockType copy via a small subclass. Do not serialize the asset graph.
